appStoreText.description:
Say it privately. Go live publicly. You choose, every time.

SogoApp brings private chat, voice and video calls, live streams and reels together in one app, with screenshot and screen-recording protection that you control.

PRIVACY YOU CONTROL
• Screenshot and screen-recording protection for chats, calls and lives: switch it on whenever you want
• During a call, the app can detect a second phone filming the screen and warn you. Detection runs on your phone and is not perfect
• View-once photos and videos
• Find people by @username, without handing out your phone number

CHAT AND CALLS
• One-to-one and group chats with photos, videos, voice messages and files
• Voice and video calls, one-to-one or in a group
• Switch a voice call to video in one tap
• Status updates for your contacts

GO LIVE AND DISCOVER
• Go live to your contacts, or to everyone on Discover
• Invite co-hosts to join your live
• Save your live as a reel

REELS
• Reels from 10 seconds to 3 minutes
• Sounds, camera filters and text posts
• Comments, including voice notes

FOR CREATORS
• Receive gifts from fans during your lives and on your reels
• See how your reels perform

YOUR LANGUAGE
SogoApp speaks 18 languages, including English, Urdu, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish, Polish, Romanian and Ukrainian, with a full right-to-left layout for Arabic and Urdu.

Gifts are sent with coins bought through the App Store. The price is shown before you pay.
